scope: typed native PulseAudio pactl endpoint summary in the bounded Ternux guest diagnostic

behavior: Runs only native `pactl info` with a five-second timeout.
Allow-lists only server name and default sink; malformed values remain unknown.
Distinguishes command/server unavailable from malformed or timed-out unknown state.
Does not send audio, start or stop services, or alter configuration.
Keeps Ternux `pulseaudio` process-name status separate from native pactl endpoint state and guest audio check.

limitations: This confirms control status only, not audible playback.
A successful point check does not erase earlier intermittent guest failures or establish long-term reliability.
It does not establish existing Ternux guest/profile ownership or host renderer.
A second point check at 01:26:38 UTC returned the same endpoint/control state; this is still not an audible or sustained playback test.
